findings.fact: 106,429 rows: 31,281 Started, 38,333 Milestone and 36,815 Resolved.

25,821 milestone rows belong to same-track/same-UTI groups of size 2 or 3. Current core emits separate threshold events at one tick, but frozen package drops level and is not receipt-bound to current defaults.
It is a same-time physical stream-splitting ordinal preserving row multiplicity, not business threshold or occurrence identity.

5,534 tracks resolve without Started and have no milestone rows. Current core can create a quote track before any hit, emit Started only on first hit, then resolve by breakthrough/timeout. These are consistent with quote-track termination without observed Absorb interaction start; exact frozen-run attribution remains unbound.

63 rows across 30 symbol-local tracks have wall_local_no=0. Current core leaves active_wall_id=0 when no exact active Wall can bind, while current FRP typed ingress rejects missing/zero dependent Wall identity.

Current code defines FeatureRunIdentity+track local number, typed Wall identity, milestone level, resolved reason and availability. Frozen package lacks receipt/source-run identity and milestone level; availability is code 1 only.
